title: Signature Dish Carousel
description: Autoplaying, horizontally scrollable carousel of signature dishes, each with a photo, optional tag, name, description, and price, plus an optional link to more.
useWhen: Several signature dishes should be browsed one at a time or side by side
A moving showcase of menu highlights with prices is wanted above a link to the full menu
avoidWhen: Every item must stay visible at once
The items have no photo or price

title: Contact & Hours
description: Two-column contact block that lists email, phone, and catering channels beside a panel of opening hours with an optional label, note, and link.
useWhen: A page should publish contact channels and opening hours together
Guests need to know when a location is open and how to reach it
avoidWhen: Only opening hours or only contact details are needed
The content is a full support or FAQ section rather than a short contact block

title: Site Footer
description: Shared site footer with the brand mark and tagline, link columns, contact details, opening hours, and a bottom copyright bar.
useWhen: The site needs one shared footer rendered across every page
Link columns, contact details, and hours should appear together below the content
avoidWhen: A page needs a local end-of-page block rather than the site-wide footer
There are no link columns, contact details, or hours to list

title: Site Header Navigation
description: Fixed site header with the brand wordmark, active-aware desktop navigation, a primary call to action, and a mobile sheet menu.
useWhen: The site needs one shared header rendered across every page
Primary navigation and a single call to action should stay pinned to the top
avoidWhen: A page needs its own local navigation rather than the site-wide header
Navigation must render below the first screen

title: Poster Hero
description: Full-screen photo opener with an eyebrow, the page headline, a description, a primary and optional secondary action, and supporting badges.
useWhen: A page needs one above-the-fold opener built on a single strong photograph
The page headline and its main call to action must appear immediately
avoidWhen: A hero already opens the same page
The opening statement needs no imagery or supporting badges

title: Farm Sourcing Story
description: Two-column sourcing story that pairs a farm photograph with a heading, supporting facts, an optional link, and a band of headline numbers.
useWhen: A page should explain where its ingredients come from
Provenance facts and headline numbers belong beside a sourcing photo
avoidWhen: The claim is a single sentence without facts or numbers
No sourcing photo is available

title: Store Locations & Map
description: Directory of store locations that pairs a details card per store, with photo, address, hours, phone, and a directions link, with one embedded map of all locations.
useWhen: A page should list physical store locations with their address, hours, and phone
Guests need a map and per-store directions for the same set of locations
avoidWhen: There are no physical locations to visit
A single address needs only one line of copy without a map

title: Menu Catalog
description: Filterable, sortable menu catalog with category tabs, dietary filter toggles, a sort control, and dish cards showing photo, badges, description, and price.
useWhen: A menu page should let visitors focus on one category at a time
Visitors should filter dishes by dietary badges and sort by price or name
avoidWhen: Only a small fixed selection of dishes is shown without browsing controls
The dishes carry no category or dietary badge data

title: Menu Page Header
description: Menu page opener with an eyebrow, the page headline, a description, and a row of highlight pills; it owns the menu page h1.
useWhen: The menu page needs its single h1 and a short introduction above the catalog
A few scan-friendly highlights should sit under the menu headline
avoidWhen: The page already has an opener or h1
The menu page needs filtering or sorting rather than an introduction

title: Ordering Channels
description: Display-only ordering guide that lists the pickup, delivery, and catering channels with an icon, a description, an optional link, and a closing note.
useWhen: A page should explain how guests can order without taking the order itself
Pickup, delivery, and catering options need a short side-by-side comparison
avoidWhen: The page must capture, submit, or pay for an order
One ordering channel needs only a single sentence of context

title: Seasonal New Items Grid
description: Responsive grid of seasonal items, each with a badge over its photo plus name, description, and price, with an optional link below.
useWhen: A fixed set of new or seasonal items should be compared in one view
Each item needs a short seasonal label over its photo
avoidWhen: The item list is long enough to need horizontal browsing
The items carry no seasonal label

title: Guest Review Grid
description: Responsive grid of guest reviews, each with a star rating, a quoted testimonial, and the reviewer's photo, name, and role.
useWhen: A page should show several guest reviews with ratings at once
Each review carries a reviewer photo, name, and role
avoidWhen: The feedback is a single long case study rather than short quotes
Reviews have no rating or reviewer photo
